name: Gathering nodes of Pale Reach and the other custom areas are back
contract: rev_20261027_60_coa_gathermate_nodes replaced the nodes of the areas the Ascension GatherMate2 data covers, and Pale Reach (area 10302) was left without nodes. rev_20261103_10_coa_restore_custom_zone_nodes restores the nodes, with their pools, of every area that has no node of the same profession within 250 yd. The Bruiseweed 1622 spawn 9963015 in Pale Reach is in no pool, so it is spawned once a player is there.

steps.label: the restored Pale Reach Bruiseweed is spawned
